notes: Two branches meet at Ibn Wahb: the first names him as عبد الله بن وهب, the second writes ابن وهب after «قالا»; he sits at the end of each branch and the tail starts at يونس, so no route names him twice
«وحرملة» and «أبو الطاهر» are co-transmitters (و joins them); «أخبراه» refers back to the السائب and عبيد الله pair
The Companion عمر is the last link: he is quoted as hearing the Prophet
